speaker: Doctor
text: I understand you are experiencing fatigue, abdominal pain, night sweats, weight loss, and enlarged supraclavicular lymph nodes. To better understand your condition, how long have these symptoms been present?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for that information; the duration of four weeks and significant weight loss are concerning. Given your "drenching" night sweats, have you recently had a fever or a rash?

REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count (CBC)
REQUEST TEST: Liver_Function_Tests (LFTs)

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma (DLBCL).

The combination of B-symptoms (fever, night sweats, weight loss), supraclavicular lymphadenopathy, elevated LDH, and a CBC showing lymphocytosis with CD20 positivity and high proliferative index is highly specific for an aggressive B-cell lymphoma. Further imaging is needed to stage the disease.

REQUEST IMAGES: PET/CT Scan
